name: Geological Survey of Queensland open data
notes: Queensland's geoscience/open-data portal: CSG, coal and petroleum reports incl. six-monthly cumulative production and CSG water readings (company-reported data published by the department). resources.qld.gov.au 403s plain fetchers - the GSQ portal is the data entry. Evidence: data.qld.gov.au + geoscience.data.qld.gov.au surfaced via web search 2026-10-29.
